facts.text: Paul Smith's College is the only four-year college located inside the Adirondack Park, featuring a 14,200-acre lakeside property with an on-campus sawmill, biathlon range, and lumberjack arena.

sources.title: The Adirondacks - Paul Smith's College
sources.quote: We're the only four-year college in the world-famous Adirondack Park. The only campus in the country with a student-run sawmill, a biathlon range, and a lumberjack sports arena.

sources.title: Fun Facts - Paul Smith's College
sources.quote: Paul Smith's College has 14,200 acres of land, the same size as Manhattan.
